title: Grade 12 ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — General Assessment #5

pages.quiz:
ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #5
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school
   B. Mocking other people’s beliefs
   C. Refusing to help a neighbour
   D. Skipping all moral lessons

2. Which response best shows understanding of Science of Qur’an? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Science of Qur’an with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Use Science of Qur’an to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Science of Qur’an.
   D. Say Science of Qur’an has no place in daily life.

3. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Telling the truth and keeping trust
   B. Spreading rumours
   C. Hiding stolen items
   D. Cheating in exams

4. Which response best shows understanding of Islamic values? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Islamic values with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Say Islamic values has no place in daily life.
   C. Use Islamic values to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Islamic values.

5. Which response best shows understanding of Care for the elderly? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Care for the elderly.
   B. Say Care for the elderly has no place in daily life.
   C. Use Care for the elderly to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Apply the teaching of Care for the elderly with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

6. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Pollute rivers deliberately
   B. Waste food daily
   C. Care for the environment and use resources wisely
   D. Destroy trees without planting

7. Which response best shows understanding of Inheritance? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Inheritance.
   B. Apply the teaching of Inheritance with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Say Inheritance has no place in daily life.
   D. Use Inheritance to insult classmates of other faiths.

8. Which response best shows understanding of Administration of Islamic Law? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Administration of Islamic Law.
   B. Say Administration of Islamic Law has no place in daily life.
   C. Apply the teaching of Administration of Islamic Law with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Use Administration of Islamic Law to insult classmates of other faiths.

9. Which response best shows understanding of Selected Hadith? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Selected Hadith.
   B. Use Selected Hadith to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Apply the teaching of Selected Hadith with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Say Selected Hadith has no place in daily life.

10. Which response best shows understanding of Principles of handling disagreements in Islam? (1 mark)
   A. Use Principles of handling disagreements in Islam to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Apply the teaching of Principles of handling disagreements in Islam with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Say Principles of handling disagreements in Islam has no place in daily life.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Principles of handling disagreements in Islam.

11. Which response best shows understanding of Science of Hadith? (1 mark)
   A. Use Science of Hadith to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Science of Hadith.
   C. Say Science of Hadith has no place in daily life.
   D. Apply the teaching of Science of Hadith with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

12. Which response best shows understanding of Islamic Finance? (1 mark)
   A. Use Islamic Finance to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Islamic Finance.
   C. Apply the teaching of Islamic Finance with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Say Islamic Finance has no place in daily life.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Care for the elderly and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Islamic values and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Prohibitions in Islam and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Retention of Islamic values and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
pages.answers:
MARKING SCHEME
====

1. A — Listening to others and living values taught at home and school

2. A — Apply the teaching of Science of Qur’an with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

3. A — Telling the truth and keeping trust

4. A — Apply the teaching of Islamic values with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

5. D — Apply the teaching of Care for the elderly with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

6. C — Care for the environment and use resources wisely

7. B — Apply the teaching of Inheritance with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

8. C — Apply the teaching of Administration of Islamic Law with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

9. C — Apply the teaching of Selected Hadith with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

10. B — Apply the teaching of Principles of handling disagreements in Islam with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

11. D — Apply the teaching of Science of Hadith with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

12. C — Apply the teaching of Islamic Finance with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

13. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Care for the elderly; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

14. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Islamic values; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

15. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Prohibitions in Islam; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

16. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Retention of Islamic values; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.
